status.reason: contact positions were computed by the authors (LeGUI/SPM12, pre-implant MRI co-registered to post-implant CT) and shown only as 3D renders for subjects 1-3 (NeurIPS 2025 paper Fig. 3, shaft letters + contact counts, no region names); the deposit has no electrode names or coordinates (Nihon Kohden .EEG files without the .21E/.PNT/.LOG sidecars; bipolar .npy arrays without channel labels)
status.regions_stated_source: paper only says trajectories 'span various cortical and subcortical regions' (Fig. 3 caption); no region named

sfreq.source: paper Sec 3.3 (Nihon Kohden EEG 1200, 1000 Hz); mne read_raw_nihon on Sub1_Sample_Original.EEG reports 1000 Hz; derivative npy at 200 Hz (paper Sec 4.2)

country.source: paper affiliations (CUHK-Shenzhen, HIT Shenzhen); recording site not named

EthicsApprovals: Collected under the approval of the institutional Ethics Review Board (ERB) at the affiliated medical center (name and number not published; NeurIPS checklist item 9)
